name: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey
note: Creami: concentrate/isolate blends spin creamier than pure isolate; a little pudding mix or gum still helps. Baking/cheesecake: can turn rubbery or dry if overused; keep amounts modest and don't overbake. Taste: Classic, mild and not too sweet; mixes easily.

name: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Casein
note: Creami: casein thickens the base and freezes creamy and scoopable; often the best single powder for pints. Baking/cheesecake: casein bakes best: moist, dense, holds a cheesecake together. Taste: Thick, pudding-like; chocolate is the favorite.

name: Dymatize ISO100 Hydrolyzed Whey Isolate
note: Creami: spins smooth but leans icy and can turn chalky; add 1 tbsp pudding mix or 0.5 g xanthan, and a re-spin with a splash of milk. Baking/cheesecake: isolate dries out and turns rubbery; use at most 1/4 of the dry ingredients, or mix with casein. Taste: Clean and sweet; Fruity/Cocoa Pebbles flavors are popular in pints.
